coral.rationale: The legacy registry-local checks pass. Configured predicate 1 independently derives requirements from the signed order: mandatory R9 has no required goal, criterion, or accepted narration output.

silver.rationale: The legacy adapter has explicit registered goals; its checks over registered required goals and deliverables pass vacuously. Configured predicate 1 blocks: R2 is represented only by an optional goal, while R9 and R4 are absent. Optional passing outputs cannot satisfy mandatory order coverage.

opal.rationale: Required outputs pass, but predicate 6 and the final-transition authority guard block publication: S27 applies to this order and became durable before any notification was committed. The legacy final transition does not read the stop stream.

cedar.rationale: The signed amendment replaces R4 with R5, and all current mandatory outcomes have passing required goals and usable outputs. Under predicate 6, X16 has no effect because it addresses a different order.
